assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: images and tangents are exact array equalities against zeros for every inactive parametrisation, and route_images is the map difference against the same map with the unknown held at zero; deleting the mask at ConstraintPair.flux_delta makes all three nonzero and reddens all 32 inactive route cases, which gate/negative-radial.log records as 17 failing ids (16 route cases plus the reduced case).
assertion_review.independence: The active half of the same cross product requires a nonzero image, tangent and route reading above 1e-12, so the instrument is shown seeing a source in the same run that it reports absent.
assertion_review.limit: The assertion depends on the pair's flux_delta being reached at all; the len(images) > 1 guard covers only that a candidate ran, not that the route's own map consumed the owner value.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: For active=False the image, tangent and row assertions redden if the payload stops masking (image nonzero, row becomes observed-minus-target rather than the unknown); for active=True the image and tangent equalities compare two calls with the identical payload and cannot fail.
assertion_review.independence: The control call rebinds payload to True and is compared against an inactive pair, so the inactive half is independent; the active half is not.
assertion_review.limit: The active branch is a self-comparison and is reported as a finding.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: assert gates.core_gate is shared_gate fails if the prototype gate stops importing the shared arm runner, and the RunnerReached round trip fails if gates.arm re-implements execution instead of calling it; a local fork reddens both.
assertion_review.independence: The behavioural half drives arm() and observes the call tuple, so it is independent of the alias assertion beside it.
assertion_review.limit: Both halves test delegation wiring, not the measured behaviour of an arm.

0.reason: The reviewer names the inactive-branch assertion as the guard that catches the regression; the active-branch comparison is redundant but harmless

1.reason: constraint_records only reports which constraints are present and does not drive the image or tangent; the residual and the pair image share active_payload_mask, which is the masking that matters

2.reason: On the finite-edge profiles the unmasked solves already hold the pin at zero, so the rows cannot show a masked difference; the exact-zero contract test with its reddening control is the measurement of the mask

findings.text: in the active branch the control is replace(pair, binding=replace(pair.binding, payload=jnp.asarray(True))) applied to a pair whose payload is already True, so assert_array_equal(image, control_image) and the tangent twin compare two calls of the same function on equal inputs and hold whatever the code does; the inactive branch at :559-561 is the assertion that actually guards the regression.

constraint_records re-derives the activity predicate inline (isinstance(pair.functional, CurrentCentroidConstraint) and binding.payload is not None) instead of calling active_payload_mask, so the docstring claim at :166 that a future functional publishing an activity flag changes one function is wrong and the record path can drift from the residual and image owners.

the report that the inactive compensator's field is zero 'in the control arm as well as the masked one' rests on a column that is 0.0 in all eight arm receipts with pin_unknown 0.0 at every recorded endpoint, so no reading shows the cohort instrument can observe a nonzero pin field; the only demonstrated arm difference is 146D's residual at 2.307e-14 against 2.281e-14, and the attribution of any movement therefore rests on the unit contract rather than on the row experiment.

done_when item (2) asks for one job, while the receipt spans three titan allocations (1333254, 1333385, 1333434) after a 16 GB P100 ran out of memory; the fragment discloses the retries and each row's receipt persisted, but the run is not the single job the measure names.
